purpose: Teach: 下地/吉村/日野/松原/三田/岩崎/山岡/稲葉

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、下地刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: Detective Shimoji's field response has been recognized as well.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Respectful nod in the voice. Steady, measured cadence. Slightly formal but not distant—genuinely appreciative of the work being named.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人吉村氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: And I understand you've been careful in taking statements from the witness, Yoshimura.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal. Conversational but with the weight of procedural care. Gentle pace—this matters. No rush. Implied trust in how this is being handled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者日野氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: You've shown consideration toward the Hino family as well, given what they've been through.
lines.style: Quieter here, almost tender. The acknowledgment of difficult work. Slow, deliberate. A pause before the name—honoring the gravity. Not performative, genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者松原氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: The witness Matsuhara's statement has been carefully documented.
lines.style: Factual but not cold. Slight uplift on 「供述」—the word for statement carries weight. Professional rhythm. A small note of completion in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、東京三田の事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: You're handling the Tokyo Mita case as well.
lines.style: Observant, steady. Not a question—a recognition of stretched resources and capable hands. Light respect in the tone. Matter-of-fact, but the subtext is: I see how much you're carrying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の岩崎家のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: The Iwasaki family has received your consideration too.
lines.style: Warmth returning. Almost tender again. The repeated structure of care becomes a rhythm—a recognition of pattern. Unhurried. Genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士山岡様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: I see you've consulted with psychologist Yamaoka for guidance.
lines.style: Approving, measured. The word 「助言」 gets a slight emphasis—seeking wisdom, not just procedure. Calm respect. A nod to doing things the right way.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の稲葉様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And you've been in pre-trial discussions with Prosecutor Inaba.
lines.style: Closer, more direct. Warmer tone—the confidence of someone who knows the work matters. Slightly more personal than the others. A gentle landing on 「協議」—the collaboration.
